name: v1.182.0
body:
## Changelog

* 16455228e50c2e30d7bc987108af54b252e260af Rename simulation journeys to episodes. (#2034)

## Breaking changes
**GenAI simulations: `journeys` renamed to `episodes`** (matches the GenAI API)
The `doctl evaluation simulation-run` subcommands were renamed. The old command
names have been **removed** — scripts using them will fail with "unknown command".
| Old                                       | New                                        |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `simulation-run list-journeys <run-uuid>` | `simulation-run list-episodes <run-uuid>`  |
| `simulation-run get-journey <run> <id>`   | `simulation-run get-episode <run> <id>`    |
- `get-trajectory` / `get-trajectory-url` keep their names; their second argument
  is now `<episode-uuid>` (was `<journey-uuid>`).
- Short aliases `ls-j` and `g-j` continue to work.
- JSON output (`-o json`) field names changed: `total_journeys` → `total_episodes`,
  `journeys_finished` → `episodes_finished`, `journey_uuid` → `episode_uuid`,
  `journey_index` → `episode_index`.
